legal_function: Creates the Court and defines crimes, jurisdiction, admissibility, cooperation, and institutional structure.
political_tension: Only binds states parties directly, subject to jurisdictional extensions and referrals.
lawyer_check: Identify jurisdictional basis before treating the ICC as generally competent.

legal_function: Receives information, opens preliminary examinations/investigations, requests warrants, and prosecutes cases.
political_tension: Prosecutorial selection is scrutinized for legitimacy, consistency, and resource limits.
lawyer_check: Separate legal threshold, evidentiary sufficiency, gravity, and policy discretion.

legal_function: Reviews warrants, summonses, confirmation of charges, and procedural safeguards.
political_tension: Judicial authorization can become the public focal point of legitimacy disputes.
lawyer_check: Track authorization, confirmation, and challenge stages distinctly.

legal_function: Adjudicate guilt, sentence, appeals, reparations, and procedural fairness.
political_tension: Length, cost, acquittals, and evidentiary complexity shape public confidence.
lawyer_check: Distinguish indictment politics from proved individual guilt.

legal_function: Budget, elections, amendments, administration, and oversight by member states.
political_tension: State support, funding, and elections affect Court capacity and legitimacy.
lawyer_check: Consider institutional incentives without collapsing judicial independence into politics.
